item.description:
Location: Boston Harbor
Description:

Deckhand positions are available on a dayboat tug fleet operating in Boston Harbor. These local commuting roles require availability for call-outs, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Responsibilities include ship-assist, towing, line handling, barge work, and vessel maintenance. Applicants need a valid MMC and TWIC (AB preferred, OS required), a driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the ability to pass a drug screening. Previous tugboat experience is preferred but not essential, as training is provided. The role offers competitive union pay, overtime, benefits, and advancement opportunities.



Apply to this job
